subject: Medford High School Student Safety Walkout
overview: Dozens of Medford High School students walked out of class to advocate for safety changes following a stabbing at the school. The students met with the mayor of Medford to share their concerns.

items.title: Student Walkout and Safety Demands
items.summary: Dozens of Medford High School students walked out of school to demand safety improvements and express concerns to the mayor after a 17-year-old student was stabbed in a school bathroom on Monday.
